dedupe_keys.name: insivumeh guatemala national seismological network data on request and hazard bulletins

description: INSIVUMEH, the Guatemalan national institute for seismology, volcanology, meteorology and hydrology, supplies seismological data from its national network of stations on request. The request page says users specify the seismological data they need through an online procedure; a technician collects the data, the seismology section reviews it and it is sent to the requester through the system, taking about one day and eight hours, free of charge, with a sociolinguistic form to complete. The institute's site also has an earthquake map, a page on the national seismological network, daily and special bulletins, volcanic hazard maps, volcano surveillance cameras and technical reports, and sections on climatology, hydrology, oceanography and its station networks. No licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the station page loads its content by script, so the number and type of stations could not be read, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is Guatemala. It supports earthquake and volcanic hazard exposure and emergency response analysis for roads, bridges, power and water systems; related records are the IG-EPN Ecuador seismic and volcanic data and the CRAAG Algerian seismic network.
